summary_1line: Bhishma devastates the Pandava forces while refusing to strike Sikhandin, as Arjuna advances under heavy opposition urged by Duryodhana.

image_candidates.scene_text: Bhishma stands in his chariot amid a storm of arrows, refusing to strike Sikhandin while calmly enduring the shafts that pierce his armor.
Dussasana fiercely defends Bhishma, raining arrows that scatter Pandava warriors, elephants, and horses across the battlefield.
Arjuna with Krishna as charioteer drives forward through converging armies as Duryodhana orders countless warriors to surround and attack him.
